content.text:
I can't compute this. The working directory has no IURC orders or case data. It holds only shell and editor config files, and those are empty device nodes. No order PDFs, text extracts or spreadsheets of the 58 orders are there. The question restricts me to files in the working directory, so I didn't look elsewhere.

I also have no reliable figures from memory for the share of 16(h) cases with the "expire" or "prior" qualifier. Any percentages I gave would be invented, so I'm not offering an estimate.

To get the answer, I need the 58 orders (or a table of their cases) placed in the working directory. With them I would do the following:
1. Extract the cite from each case.
2. Keep the cases whose base section is 16(h).
3. Divide the count with qualifier "expire" by the total 16(h) cases, then do the same for "prior". Both are rounded to one decimal.
